body_markdown:
How many tabs, terminal buffers and documentation pages do you have open right now? We know that software development can have its own rhythm, from the first set of code in the morning to late-night debug sessions. When you are shipping production code or building with AI toolchains, the hardware you use should be a reflection of what you do.


To honor the builders of tomorrow, we’re dropping our first-ever


[MX Master 4 Developer Edition](https://logi.link/1eb0f3) : a limited edition of our flagship mouse. Heading to GitHub Universe? Stop by our two-day hands-on setup in San Francisco to test out custom macros and try the mouse in person.


#### **Powerful MX Master 4 Performance, Custom Dev Styling**


- **The Syntax Aesthetic:** Features laser-etched syntax annotations (


//


), markup tags (


</>


), circuit traces, and a compiling


{Hello, World}


execution prompt printed directly onto a sleek matte body.


- **The Easter Eggs:** Subtle developer logic and open-source tributes integrated directly into the design, including


0xFF + 1


(World Programmers’ Day),


09.17


(Linux Kernel release date), and


!04.01


(World Backup Day).


- **Built on MX Master 4 Performance:**


- **Tactile code navigation:** Customizable haptic vibration feedback while scrubbing large code repos or switching terminal windows.


- **Instant tool & AI shortcuts:** A dedicated Actions Ring button offering one-click access to customizable macros and your favorite AI coding assistants.


- **Flow through tasks:** Scroll up to 1,000 lines per second and stop on a pixel with the MagSpeed Scroll Wheel, Logitech’s fastest1, quietest and most precise2 scrolling experience.


#### **Availability**


If you’re heading to GitHub Universe in San Francisco from October 28-29, stop by our booth to be the first to purchase the MX Master 4 Developer Edition Edition and test your workflow at our developer stations. This limited drop goes live starting October 27 on


[Logitech.com](https://logi.link/1eb0f3) or in select global retailers for $119.99 USD/ €119/£119.99, as well as in person at GitHub Universe while supplies last.
